# `aitbc messaging topic`

Alias of ``messaging topics`` — implicit topics have no create call.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging topic [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max topics (server caps at 100) |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Skip the first N topics (bounded) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging topic
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging topic --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
